title: やさしい日本語の音声がダウンロードできる「聴く MATCHA やさしい日本語」が始まりました！
titleTranslation: The "Listen to MATCHA Easy Japanese" service, where you can download audio of easy Japanese, has launched!
summary: MATCHA's Easy Japanese edition now offers downloadable audio of native Japanese staff reading select articles, letting learners practice natural pronunciation anytime, with some recordings free and others costing 100 yen.

sentences.text: 「MATCHA やさしい日本語版」では、日本人が　やさしい日本語の　記事を　読んでいる　音声を　ダウンロードできる「聴くMATCHA やさしい日本語」が　始まりました！
sentences.translation: In the "MATCHA Easy Japanese Edition," the service "Listen to MATCHA Easy Japanese," where you can download audio of Japanese people reading easy Japanese articles, has started!

sentences.text: 日本語を　勉強している　人に　オススメの　サービスです。
sentences.translation: This is a recommended service for people studying Japanese.

sentences.text: 記事を　聴いて　楽しもう
sentences.translation: Let's enjoy listening to articles

sentences.text: 「MATCHA やさしい日本語版」では、いくつかの　記事で　日本人が　その文を　読んだ　音声が　ダウンロードできるように　なりました(「聴く　MATCHA やさしい日本語」)。
sentences.translation: In the "MATCHA Easy Japanese Edition," it has become possible to download audio of Japanese people reading the text for some articles ("Listen to MATCHA Easy Japanese").

sentences.text: MATCHAの　日本人の　社員が　読んでいるので　日本で　生活するときに　聞こえる、自然な　日本語を　聞くことが　できます。

tokens.gloss: to be audible, to be heard

sentences.translation: Since MATCHA's Japanese staff are the ones reading, you can hear natural Japanese like what you'd hear living in Japan.

sentences.text: 音声は、1記事　100円です。
sentences.translation: The audio costs 100 yen per article.

sentences.text: いくつかは　無料で　ダウンロードできます。
sentences.translation: Some can be downloaded for free.

sentences.text: 「聴く　MATCHA やさしい日本語」：https://matcha-jp.stores.jp/
sentences.translation: "Listen to MATCHA Easy Japanese": https://matcha-jp.stores.jp/

sentences.text: こんなときに　使うと　便利！
sentences.translation: It's convenient to use at times like these!

sentences.text: 1.日本人の　日本語を　聞きたいとき
sentences.translation: 1. When you want to hear Japanese people's Japanese

sentences.text: MATCHAの　日本人の　社員が　読んでいるので、日本人が　話す　自然な　発音を　聞くことが　できます。
sentences.translation: Since MATCHA's Japanese staff are reading, you can hear the natural pronunciation that Japanese people speak with.

sentences.text: 2.日本について　知りたいとき

tokens.gloss: to attach, stick (base of 付く, used in ~について "about/regarding")

sentences.translation: 2. When you want to learn about Japan

sentences.text: MATCHAの　記事には、日本の　文化や　日本の　マナーに　関係する　記事、観光についての　記事が　たくさん　あります。

tokens.gloss: to attach, stick (base of 付く, used in ~について "about/regarding")

sentences.translation: MATCHA's articles include many articles related to Japanese culture and manners, and articles about sightseeing.

sentences.text: それらの　記事を　目で　見て、耳で　聞いて　学ぶことが　できます。
sentences.translation: You can learn those articles by both seeing them with your eyes and hearing them with your ears.

sentences.text: 3.机に　向かって　日本語を　勉強することが　難しいとき
sentences.translation: 3. When it's hard to sit at a desk and study Japanese

sentences.text: 音声は、スマートフォンが　あれば　どこでも　聞くことが　できます。
sentences.translation: As long as you have a smartphone, you can listen anywhere.

sentences.text: 電車や　車に　乗っているときなどに　音声を　聞けば、いつでも　日本語を　勉強することが　できます。
sentences.translation: If you listen to the audio while riding a train or car, you can study Japanese anytime.

sentences.text: 音声が　ある　記事の　サンプル
sentences.translation: Sample articles that have audio

sentences.text: 2020年　7月の　今は、人気の　約50記事に　音声が　入っています。
sentences.translation: As of now, July 2020, about 50 popular articles have audio.

sentences.text: 日本語の　勉強に　ぜひ　使って　くださいね。

tokens.gloss: to give (honorific); used in ください "please"

sentences.translation: Please do use it for studying Japanese.

sentences.text: 伝統的な　日本の　宿「旅館」とは？
sentences.translation: What is a traditional Japanese lodging, the "ryokan"?

sentences.text: 日本に　来る前に　知っておきたい、日本の　食事の　マナー　7つ

tokens.gloss: auxiliary verb: to do in advance (base 置く)

sentences.translation: 7 things about Japanese dining manners worth knowing before coming to Japan

sentences.text: 間違えやすい　日本語「きらい・きれい」「こわい・かわいい」
sentences.translation: Easily confused Japanese words: "kirai/kirei" and "kowai/kawaii"

sentences.text: 音声が　ある　記事を　調べたいときは、こちらで　確認して　ください。

tokens.gloss: to give (honorific); used in ください "please"

sentences.translation: If you want to look up articles that have audio, please check here.

sentences.text: 「聴く　MATCHA やさしい日本語」：https://matcha-jp.stores.jp/
sentences.translation: "Listen to MATCHA Easy Japanese": https://matcha-jp.stores.jp/
